class SpatialRelationBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, width: int) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(width)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            width,
            num_heads=4,
            dropout=0.05,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.05)
        self.feed_forward_norm = nn.LayerNorm(width)
        self.feed_forward = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(width, 2 * width),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.05),
            nn.Linear(2 * width, width),
            nn.Dropout(0.05),
        )

    def forward(self, tokens: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        normalized = self.attention_norm(tokens)
        attended = self.attention(
            normalized,
            normalized,
            normalized,
            need_weights=False,
        )[0]
        tokens = tokens + self.attention_dropout(attended)
        return tokens + self.feed_forward(self.feed_forward_norm(tokens))
